title: Unit Event — Our Constellation of Song

meta.Outline: Leo/need has done it at last. They've been signed by a record label! Reflecting on all of the people whose support has taken them this far, Ichika thinks of a way for the band to show their gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, it's signed here and all sealed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That should do it for our contract.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They were definitely worried about us signing with a label at first, but I'm glad Mom and Dad agreed to this...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They even said they'd be willing to support us after I told them why we're going pro...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's on top of going through all the fine print and discussing our finances... That really put me at ease.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All that's left is to hand this over to Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And I think it's almost time for me to go.
Where'd I put my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I still have a little time.
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “The Perseid meteor shower, one of Japan's three biggest meteor shower events, is just over the horizon. This event will go on for about a month, with the peak days being...”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me of the time we watched one when we were little...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We practiced playing that Miku song and just happened to see it happen on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't believe how beautiful it was...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But then, in junior high...
We slowly began to drift apart...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure if we'd ever get to watch another meteor shower together like that again...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It'd be great to see another one together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi! Did you fill out your contract okay? I'll lend you my pen if you forgot to sign anywhere!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-That's okay. My parents went over it with me multiple times at home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good to hear!
Tsukasa and I totally panicked earlier this morning after I found a spot that I forgot to sign.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry, Saki, only you would be so scatterbrained.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Anyway, shall we head in...?
We wouldn't want to keep Mr. Shindo waiting.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Okay, I think we're all set.
I officially accept your contracts.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes. From now on, you'll be producing music under this label. We're looking forward to seeing you get started.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: W-We did it! We're finally pros...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the same time... We knew a while back that we'd be doing this, so I don't think this part is anything to get so excited about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh? Then, Shiho, why are you grinning?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I-I'm just... I mean, of course I'm happy for us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... We finally made it to this point...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm still not sure what it means to commit to trying to become a pro...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I know that I want to be in a band with you, Shiho. I want to perform in shows with you. I want others to be moved by our music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that means aiming to become professionals, so be it...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We made the decision to go pro that time...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We didn't know if it'd actually be possible, and there were times when we felt unsure of ourselves...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We won't be debuting for a while... But we should be able to play in front of more and more people compared to before.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And I want to do everything I can to move their hearts... Through our music.)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Now, about how things will proceed moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Your band will be making its debut as an artist for the label sometime in the future.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, there's a list of preparations that need to be made before you can.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Well, you need to produce some new songs, while we need to promote your name around your debut date.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll start putting some proposals together soon that discuss how you might be billed and such.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Naturally, that includes what kind of band you want to become, how you wish to be perceived and what your music means to you.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You'll need to know those things in order to see what you wish to achieve. And we can't do any marketing if we don't know what you want.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I'll set up some meetings for us in the future to discuss all of that. So, let's take the time to talk through it all carefully.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Then, that's about it for today...
Again, your contracts all seem to be in order, so I'll be taking them.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: We unfortunately need a bit of lead time with these... So, for now, please keep practicing as you have been.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And feel free to contact me if anything comes up on your end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much for talking with us today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it was also a relief to hear that all our contracts were in order...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'd been feeling anxious about today for so long. We can finally relax a little...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But signing with a label wasn't our goal. We still have a lot of work ahead of us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We'll need to start thinking about what's going to happen moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But for now, we should just follow Mr. Shindo's advice and keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In any case, we've done what we needed to today, so let's go home...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. And it's already getting dark...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was just reminded of something I saw on the news this morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Apparently, the Perseid meteor shower is happening soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Was that supposed to be a joke?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hey, I couldn't hear what she said clearly!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. The Perseid meteor shower, yes?
It's one of the three biggest meteor showers you can see in Japan. And the timing does seem right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A meteor shower...
Remember the one we saw when we were little? Good times.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That one was the Leonid meteor shower...
But yes, it's quite nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...! I felt the same way this morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I was hoping that we could see another one together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! Absolutely!
We've gotta go see it!!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree...
Between shows and contract stuff, we haven't been able to take a break recently.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like to see it as well...
I still remember that night sky like I saw it yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Not only that, the wish Saki made...
What we talked about. All of it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
They're all precious memories.
And it'd be wonderful to add more to our album.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then, let's go see it.
Like we did all those years ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We made plans to go see it together without a second thought.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't wait to see this meteor shower.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I'm glad I was able to get some new picks and replacement strings.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Since we're pros now, I need to stay stocked up. Next is...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yoshizaki, it's been so long...!
Also, what a coincidence. I wasn't expecting to run into you in the middle of town like this...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Me neither...!
Sorry, I hope I didn't scare you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, it's great to see you!
How have things been since then?

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Oh, I need to thank you again for what you did!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: And... I apologize for not being able to go to your shows lately...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: The thing is, I made a promise with Hanano...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Let's see another show again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Once you've settled in at home... Promise, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I promised her that we'd go see you guys perform once she's had a chance to settle in with her new family.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: So, I felt I should hold off until she can be there to join me...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: However, I think that we'll be able to go soon...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Yes, Hanano seems to be getting along really well with her new family! They even went on a trip together the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?! I'm so glad to hear that...!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Me too! So, we've been talking about going to see Leo/need's next show together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I see... Thank goodness...
They get to be together again...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: And Leo/need made this all possible...!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Hanano told me that.
When she first moved in with her new family, there were times when she felt really lonely...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But whenever that happened, she said she always thought about the last time she saw you guys perform.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
And I know what she means.
There are times when I find myself wondering if she's okay...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: But whenever I think about the song you played during that show...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: I'm reminded of the time Hanano and I spent together. It fills me with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Also, I've listened to it more times than I can count since you guys uploaded it online. Leo/need has been a huge source of encouragement for both of us...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: So, thank you all very much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I should be the one thanking you two.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You both taught me something incredibly valuable.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Before, I just kinda wished that someone would feel moved by our music or understand what we were trying to do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But you two reminded me of what the old me went through...
You two made me want to write a song that you'd both feel a real connection to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I mentioned this during that show, but there was a time when my friends and I began drifting apart.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
As hard as that was...
I was glad my experience helped me create a song that connected with you two so strongly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, I want to keep doing that...
I want to keep playing music that gives people support and encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's what you two taught me.
Which is why I need to thank you...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
No, I...
Still, Hoshino, that does mean a lot coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget!
Do you know when you'll be performing next?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(We need to discuss that with our label...
That's not something we can decide on our own now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, we don't have any fixed plans...
But we will be doing one soon!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We promise to make it an unbelievable show that really resonates with you, so we hope you'll make it!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Of course! Hanano and I will be looking forward to seeing it!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Anyway, if you'll excuse me.
Thanks for stopping to chat!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: And you can always count on us for support!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Hanano and her brother get to be together again.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I couldn't be happier that our song helped them through such a tough period of their lives.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The joy of playing a song with someone specific in mind, and of successfully reaching them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Those two taught me what that was like.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(They're not the only ones who've taught me something important...
We were able to make it this far because we had help from a lot of different people.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Iori was the reason why we really began thinking about going pro. And she gave us a ton of valuable advice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saku's band pushed us to become better when we battled against them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And of course, all of our friends have supported us in our dream...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku and them have been watching over us this entire time...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't think we can even begin to thank them enough.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wish we could repay everyone somehow. They've all done so much...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm early. We're not supposed to meet for a little bit.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I wonder if the others are already here.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's what they've been saying, Len!
Plus, they told us about their contracts just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Sorry, I didn't mean to get so excited.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're just that happy for them, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This means they should be debuting soon. That's definitely something to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is incredible. You girls really did it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichika!
We were just telling them how we're signed to that label now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're so happy to hear that you've taken such a big step towards your dream.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your hard work is starting to finally pay off. Congratulations, girls.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we're here because of you and the others.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. As it so happens, I just ran into Yoshizaki and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's so wonderful...
Hanano and her brother get to see each other again...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and it made me start thinking...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our fans, including Hanano and her brother...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, all the other people we met after we got our band back together... Our friends, Miku and everyone... We've made it this far because of them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So that's what you meant by what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes. So, I began wondering to myself...
Isn't there anything we can do for everyone who's been there for us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it would be nice to thank them somehow...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Especially since they've given us so much!
But how do we show our appreciation for them...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you wish to show your appreciation for others, why not do what you'd normally do...? By playing music.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
H-He's right...!
If we're saying our thanks as a band, music's easily the best way to go!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree. That's probably the best option...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...! We can thank them by playing music for them...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's ask Mr. Shindo about this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! We're signed to a label now, so we can't just do shows whenever we like anymore.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like things are about to get very busy...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <You wish to put on a show for all the people who've supported you up until this point.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes, that's right...! At the very least, we'd like to thank them somehow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We understand that we can't just do whatever we like since we're signed now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we feel that we need to do this...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <This is an important period for your band since it's when we're going to decide how you'll be marketed.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <And we haven't decided on anything yet. Doing a show now may have ramifications on things down the road... To be honest, I can't just give you the green light.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <You have a clear purpose in mind for this show, so we should be able to do something about all the red tape.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Plus, it may be good for you to cap off this chapter of your lives before you start working as pros in earnest.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <You are free to do this show.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <The president's probably going to have some questions, but I'll just say that you've been planning this since before you signed with us...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
<I'll be looking forward to the show.
We'll talk again soon.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! We get to do our show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But the hard part starts now.
This is gonna be just like our solo show. We have a huge list of stuff to get done.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, things should be smoother this time around since we've done this once already...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's do our best to make our Thank You Show a really amazing one! How about it?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Ladies of Leo/need! Thank you for agreeing to gather here today. Now, let's start discussing our Thank You Show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, who are you supposed to be...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll start. I came up with this set list...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, the ticket site looks set, and so do our flyers...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And we have a set list!
We're up to ten songs, though. That's more than for our solo show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But they're all songs that we want to play, and I think each one is necessary for the flow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, in order to get through it, we'll need to keep working on our stamina.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Now, as for when and where we'll be playing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, about that... I want to get everyone's thoughts on something...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I was thinking that the live house Shiho works at would be best since we owe them quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But then, yesterday, I got a call from Mr. Shindo...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Hello. I apologize for calling you so suddenly. The thing is, I have a suggestion regarding the show we discussed the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Yes. If your band hasn't decided where to play yet, there's a venue that I'd like you to consider.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I'll send a link to their site now.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <I believe this is where Leo/need performed in front of an audience for the very first time...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Apparently, they need a replacement after the band that was supposed to play dropped out suddenly.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <If we act now, I may be able to book it for fairly cheap.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We'd be returning to the place where we played in front of an audience for the very first time...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But... Are we ready to play there...?)

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Of course, I understand that selling enough tickets to fill this place out will be challenging...>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <However, the experience of putting on a show at a large venue such as this one will undoubtedly prove beneficial to you as professionals.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <Consider it a lucky turn of events and an opportunity to prepare for your future.>

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: <But the decision rests with you and your band. Please let me know after you've had a chance to discuss this with them...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes...! Um, so... Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, what are the odds...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's where we played our first show...
That's where we decided to go pro together. With you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That time... It was our very first show, so I just sang like there was no tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I wanted to give Shiho our answer through our music...
To tell her that we wanted to go pro with her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But we probably didn't sound very good back then... I doubt the audience actually enjoyed our performance.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (However, we should be able to do better now. We can put on a much more compelling performance.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. I want to try playing there again too, if we have this opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Let's fill that venue with a totally different sound than before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...! And if we're gonna make it as pros, we gotta start playing at some of the bigger venues.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which means we shouldn't back down from this sort of challenge!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, it's settled...
Let's go back there and put on the best show we can...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hang on... Doesn't this mean we'll be playing on the date of that meteor shower?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh...? Oh, you're right.
But we should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, since we'll have a few days to see it. Also, the peak viewing period is apparently a few days after our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, let's put on an amazing show and then go see it that night.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright!
Let's do our best to make sure that we get to enjoy it to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's okay. I just got here too.
Thank you for always taking time out of your busy schedule to practice with me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, don't mind me. I didn't have much going on today. All I really did was make a list of stage props.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, before we do...!
There's something I need to give you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here, it's a ticket for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know you saw our solo show, but I'm really hoping that you'll also come to this one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but...! You don't have to if you already have plans!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've been looking forward to going to your next show since your solo show was so much fun. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm really glad to hear that...!
Thank you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But wow, you're doing another show already.
Your band must be doing pretty well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our next show is going to be our way of thanking everyone who's been there for us until now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why, Kusanagi, I'd like for you to come...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, since you've been teaching me how to sing. And...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because you've been supporting my dream. As my friend.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate what you're saying, but... I need to thank you as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Well, um... I'm pretty shy around others and all...
Which is why I'm happy that I've gotten to know you so well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And seeing you really go after your dream has motivated me to do the same, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So you've been supporting my dream a lot as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm so glad I never stopped singing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Singing's sort of the reason we became friends.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We go to different schools, so we probably never would've met under normal circumstances...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
When I heard you sing, I was really touched!
I want to be able to sing like you too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So if you don't mind... Can you please teach me how to sing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We were able to become friends because you were willing to ask me to teach you how to sing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She's right...
Singing is what brought us together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm really glad that I started taking singing more seriously after getting our band back together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Kusanagi.
Thank you so much for everything you've taught me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...
But it's a little embarrassing when you put it that way...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be possible for you to come see our show?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be more than happy to go since you've invited me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But have I really done anything worthy of being thanked?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, Kanade, don't say that...!
You've taught me so much about writing songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You made me realize some very important things that time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. How to bring what I'm feeling into shape... And the importance of having the courage to believe in my choices.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That didn't just help me finish that song... What I learned that day will stick with me as I keep thinking about our music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't think I did anything particularly profound.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm glad I could help you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to the show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
I promise to do my very best to make sure you enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I also need to do my best to put on a good show for her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Kusanagi was right.
I'm so glad I never stopped singing or playing music...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(It's not just her.
Music is what led me to Kanade, too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Did something happen, Ichika?
You seem awfully happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was just thinking about how music gave me the opportunity to meet you, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Kusanagi and I sort of ended up talking about that when I went to invite her the other day...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How singing... How music helped expand our circle of friends.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That made me realize how music has the power to bring people together and create new connections.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I suppose you're right.
After all, that Miku CD was what led to us meeting in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That CD is what led to us talking like this, and then you taught me how to create my own Miku songs...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Miku's certainly had quite an impact.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, she has...
I mean, Kanade and I do talk about her a lot.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. Then, in other words...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Miku is in essence the one who brought you two together, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(She might be right...
Miku's the reason why Kanade and I are friends at all...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Meeting Miku in SEKAI brought us back together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (After the four of us reformed our band, we started meeting so many different people.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh, that reminds me...
When we were little, we decided to start a band because I'd listened to all those Miku songs and wanted to play them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Music has given me a chance to meet all these people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But Miku stands at the center of all that. She brought us all together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, Hoshino, it sounds like Miku's had the biggest impact on your life...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, thank goodness! There you are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is everything okay?
Practice isn't supposed to start until much later, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's right...
But I wanted to talk with you before that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. So, we started preparing for that show we talked about the other day...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which gave me a chance to think.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Singing and music have allowed me to meet and connect with all these different people...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku, you connected me with so many people...
Not only that, you helped reunite me with my best friends.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I really need to thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, I think I've said something similar before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your songs have such incredible powers...
Not only did they help bring my old friends back together, they're helping me make new ones as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been able to meet so many new faces, thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I could see your sincerity when you said that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Neither I nor the Miku of your world deserve all the credit, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You did all the hard work.
You took your feelings seriously.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I think you're an incredible person, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because you've also brought so many people together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. You did everything you could to bring Leo/need back together, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I don't deserve all the credit.
Saki was really vocal about...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, what about that brother and sister who ended up becoming separated?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You did your absolute best to write lyrics for them, and you succeeded in bringing them back together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why I believe you have the power to bring people together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like the person you admire so much. The Miku from your world.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I did, huh...?
I brought them together... Like you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you're capable of even more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As you keep playing music that moves the hearts of more and more people. As you convey how you really feel...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You'll sing songs that can bring more and more people together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At least, that's what I believe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll treasure what you've taught me and keep bringing more people together through music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good. And I'll keep supporting you as best I can, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're cleaning up that classroom over there and were hoping that you'd lend us a quick hand!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, then, should I join as well?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But you have practice soon.
You should be focusing your energy on your show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So, I'll see you later.
I'm looking forward to seeing your show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Bye bye, Ichi!
Good luck with practice and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've never thought of it that way since I've always been looking up to her. We seemed worlds apart in that sense...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This show is our chance to thank everyone for giving us so much support...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But... I believe Miku deserves a special thanks.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (How do I do that? Something that she'd really enjoy would be best...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This song is going to let me sing with all of you in your world.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Obviously, I'm not the same Miku that's in your world...
However, while listening to this song, I got the feeling that it connects me to all of you girls.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichi, you're already here!
You must be raring to go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, so... I have a suggestion regarding our next show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't know if it's actually possible, but I'd like to give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, give what a try? Tell us more!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, this seems like the right place...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki. Thank goodness I found you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena and Emu are just over there.
They said Honami also invited them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, we should see the show together!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, let's. I'm very much looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...! There's so many people here now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and they're all here to see us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Standing here really brings back memories of when we played in front of an audience for the very first time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. As nostalgic as that is, I felt so nervous that time... But now, I think my excitement is winning out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We've done a bunch of shows since then, but I've had fun every single time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's make this our best performance yet.
Sounds like you're all more than ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much for coming.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And thank you for booking this venue for us. We couldn't be more grateful...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I was just doing my job as your manager.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Plus, I'm personally looking forward to seeing Leo/need play...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Mr. Shindo...
There's actually something I've been meaning to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
For giving a band of high schoolers like us a chance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've been meaning to thank you for quite a while now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's always been my dream to become a professional musician. I can't say that it's come true yet since we still haven't actually made our debut, but it's within my grasp now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This show is about thanking all those who've been there for us along the way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that includes you, Mr. Shindo. So, we hope you really enjoy it to the end.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because we're gonna make it a good one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, me! I wanna go next!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't thank you enough, Mr. Shindo!
You gave me the push I needed to actually decide on going pro!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, we're gonna do our very best to show you our appreciation today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we're going to do what we can to make you feel glad that you decided to take a chance with us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's do our usual thing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, get your star pieces ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's been a long journey...
We'd drifted far apart, but ended up getting our band back together. We even decided to try to go pro, which led us here...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we have so many people to thank for making this happen.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, let's give them a proper thank you. Let's give them the best show they've ever seen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I really can't wait since Hoshino sounded so eager...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all for joining us here today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you! We hope you enjoyed our first song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm so happy to be singing in front of such a large audience!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This place actually means quite a lot to us since it's where we decided to start pursuing music seriously...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: As a band, we were still just getting on our feet back then... We didn't know how to play well in front of a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But a lot has happened since then...
And we met people like all of you who were willing to give us their support.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Compared to before, I believe we've become much better at putting on performances that resonate with a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we couldn't have come this far without your support.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, as a small token of our appreciation... We're going to put on the best show we've ever done!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (Who would've thought they'd get this good...?)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (They're like a completely different band now compared to the last time they were here.)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (I liked how they just put their feelings out in the open, but they were really desperate that time...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: (In contrast, they're a single unit now and having a total blast.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I feel a little tired...
But the audience seems to be enjoying everything.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to say a few words before we move to our next song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, all this time I've been playing music, there's something I've felt again and again...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Music helps us communicate our feelings, and brings people together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Music is what brought us together here today. It's allowed me to meet so many people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And our next song...
It's meant to be a beacon of hope for those who've drifted apart but wish to see each other again someday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We hope it helps even a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's the feeling I'll have in my heart as I sing.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: (I felt so much pain for so long. It didn't matter what I told myself. The thought of having to live away from Yota was horrible...)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: (But every time I hear this song... It always gives me so much encouragement... It pushes me to move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: (Including doing what I can to get along with my new family... And I'm here right now because of it.)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
I'm really glad I'm here...
I couldn't be happier that I get to see this show with you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Ichika's pulling us forward...
I can feel more and more energy flowing into our performance.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(This feels awesome...
I bet we can play even better!)

rows.Speaker: Miu's Friend A
rows.Line: Hey, what were they called? Leo/need? They're amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miu's Friend B
rows.Line:
I know, right?! I just learned about them the other day, but they've written all these unbelievable songs.
Aren't you glad you came?

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: I plan on trying a little more at my next school.

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: Things might go well, but they might not. Whenever I feel sad or dejected, I'll just play my guitar...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line: But I don't plan on giving up. I'm gonna keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Miu
rows.Line:
So please, Hinomori...
Do the same.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The way Hoshino's singing... It's like I'm feeling what she is.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Her love of music, how much she enjoys singing and her kindness. She really wants to help others feel better...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everyone here must see this song as a huge source of encouragement.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hearing it has given them the power to stand up and move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because it tells them someone they care about is waiting for them up ahead... This song has the power to help people and bring them together.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is what Hoshino's song is all about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Next is song ten. Our last one...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for listening...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This has been beyond incredibly fun, but our next song will be our last.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I actually made this one using certain music software.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That software is called Hatsune Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To me, Miku isn't just a program for making music. I've learned so many important things from her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She taught me the power of song when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I met Miku for the first time, I began learning so much about music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku's the reason I was able to reconnect with the people I care about the most.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki, Shiho and Honami...
We're in a band now because of Miku. She brought us together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, because she's been watching over us the entire time and giving us so much support...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to sing our last song with her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Then, I hope you have a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was a little startled when Ichika said she wanted to sing with Miku...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Obviously, we can't have Miku appear as a hologram, but everyone should think that it's a computer singing if they only hear her voice...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Miku's supposed to be backstage with one of our phones hooked up to the sound system...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's like she's standing right next to Ichika and singing along with her.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Not just her voice...
It's like she's actually here singing with me.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I feel like I can sing better than I ever have... With Miku, I can do anything...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The way Ichika and I are singing, the way they're playing their instruments... It's all resonating with the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Our song is bringing us all together...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Ichika, Saki, Shiho, Honami...
When we first met, you were all so far apart.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (You all cared deeply about one another, but didn't know how to express that feeling. As a result, you ended up hurting each other...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But you did your best to overcome all that, one step at a time. You were driven by your collective desire to be friends again.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I know your kindness and the hard work you've put in better than anyone else.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That kindness gives you all the ability to empathize with those who've been hurt. It's why so many people feel so moved by your music.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(But you can do more...
I think you can make your message heard even louder and clearer...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (So, let's show them what it really means to be moved by a performance!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(The way Miku's singing...
I can feel her pulling us forward...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They're all here and really enjoying the show... We're really getting through to them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if that's what they want, then I should also...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Everyone who's been supporting me is here. I hope they understand how grateful I am...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to keep singing! I don't want to stop...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's able to sing such an inspiring song, drawing us in along with the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was starting to think I'd learned to do some of what she can... But I'm still nowhere near her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, I have to try. I want to move the hearts of the masses and express my feelings the way Miku does...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If I'm going to do that as a professional musician, I need to stop writing myself off so much...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm going to bring everyone together by singing...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (A person who heard me sing will hopefully pay it forward and help someone else, be that through song or otherwise.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Just like how Miku moved my heart all those years ago... I'm bringing everyone this song...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (To sing like Miku. To bring everyone together...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope our performance today conveyed at least some portion of our gratitude to all of you out there...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We plan to keep putting on heartfelt performances like this in the future.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, from the bottom of my heart, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you did a remarkable job.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
It really was fun...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
At the same time, I'm sorry.
I feel bad about being the only one who got to go over.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
You gotta let me go if they decide to do something like this again!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, you and the girls put on such an incredible performance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...
At times, it was Ichika who was pulling me along as we sang.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I could feel her determination slowly come to the surface...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It became clear that she wants to bring as many people together as she can through singing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That determination is sure to take Leo/need far.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what the future has in store for them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it was. It felt so great to share all that energy with the audience throughout our show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. In terms of getting our message across to a crowd, this was probably our best performance yet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you hear that?! Shiho's giving us her seal of approval!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My mind's just wandering a bit. I don't think I've fully realized that our show's over.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You really went above and beyond today, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially when you sang with Miku.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. While I was watching you during the show, Ichi, you reminded me of when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, when we first started our band!
Your eyes totally sparkled every time you sang a Miku song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. She's right...
I remember how you barged into our classroom and exclaimed, “We should play Miku songs together!” You were so excited.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that sense, Miku alone didn't bring us together... You were just as instrumental, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And we ended up playing together the first time we were all in SEKAI because of what you said back then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I believe we're standing here today because of what you did all those years ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Ichika, you've always been that way. Ever since we were little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This all reminds me of how whenever we got into a big argument over something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, like the ones Shiho and I had!
Ichi would always jump in and do her best to get us to stop fighting!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, to be fair, Ichika would usually jump in without much of a plan, and Honami would come up with a compromise for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But every time you stumbled around trying to get us to stop, Ichika, we'd end up seeing how pointless our arguments were...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So, I agree...
You've been the glue that holds us together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, did you see that streak of light?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We can already see them this clearly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We got to put on an amazing show...
And now we get to see shooting stars on the way home...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should watch this show together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go find a place with a better view.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, since we're here...
That place should actually be pretty close.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had a feeling this park would give us the best view.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Hanging out, talking and seeing a meteor shower on our way home...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You said you wanted us to be together like this forever...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I also wished for this the day before I was given the okay to go back to school.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really wanted us to see a meteor shower like this again someday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm really glad that my wish came true...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't we make the same wish again? For all of us to stay together for good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The four of us. Together. Forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So that we get to see lots more meteor showers like this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I also want us to stay together...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, I won't just wish for that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Including us. We were given the push we needed to rekindle our friendship...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to do the same for Leo/need.)
